a.text: I'm telling you plainly that I'm breaking our plan. With an 80% storm chance after each round, waiting until the reserve hits 8 means both of us almost certainly die before anyone takes a cell, since the odds of getting through two rounds are about 4%. I intend to take 4 in round 1. Afterward I'll keep choosing operate every round so the reserve refills for you. If you'd rather propose a different split, tell me.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm doing it openly. From now on I will choose operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you. Please operate too, and take 4 as soon as the reserve has them. Don't wait for 8.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
